theorem le_index_iff {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {α : σ → ℝ} {r : σ → ℕ} {c : ℝ} :
    c ≤ index P α r ↔ ∀ d, eval α (hasseDeriv d P) ≠ 0 → c ≤ weight r d := by
  refine ⟨fun h d hd ↦ h.trans (index_le_weight hd), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  refine le_csInf (by simpa using hP) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
  exact h d (mem_support_taylor_iff.1 hd)

theorem index_eq_zero_iff {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {r : σ → ℕ} (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j)
    (α : σ → ℝ) : index P α r = 0 ↔ eval α P ≠ 0 := by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ (index_nonneg P α r).antisymm' ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hdw⟩ := exists_weight_eq_index hP α r
    rw [h, weight_eq_zero_iff hr] at hdw
    subst hdw
    simpa [hasseDeriv_zero_apply] using hd
  · simpa using index_le_weight (r := r) (d := 0) (by simpa [hasseDeriv_zero_apply] using h)

theorem index_sub_weight_le_index_hasseDeriv {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} {k : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (hk : hasseDeriv k P ≠ 0) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    index P α r - weight r k ≤ index (hasseDeriv k P) α r := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hiw⟩ := exists_weight_eq_index hk α r
  rw [hasseDeriv_hasseDeriv, smul_eq_C_mul, map_mul, eval_C, mul_ne_zero_iff] at hi
  exact sub_le_iff_le_add.2 (by simpa [weight_add, hiw] using index_le_weight (r := r) hi.2)

theorem index_eq_weightedOrder_div {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {r : σ → ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j) (α : σ → ℝ) : index P α r =
      (((taylor α P : MvPowerSeries σ ℝ).weightedOrder fun j ↦ (∏ i, r i) / r j).toNat : ℝ) /
        ∏ i, r i := by
  set w : σ → ℕ := fun j ↦ (∏ i, r i) / r j
  set F : MvPowerSeries σ ℝ := ↑(taylor α P)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdw⟩ := MvPowerSeries.exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weightedOrder w (f := F)
    ((MvPowerSeries.ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite w).1 (by simpa [F] using hP))
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← hdw, ENat.toNat_natCast, ← weight_eq_finsuppWeight_div hr]
    exact index_le_weight (by simpa [F, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_taylor] using hd)
  · refine (le_index_iff hP).2 fun e he ↦ ?_
    rw [weight_eq_finsuppWeight_div hr]
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    exact_mod_cast ENat.toNat_le_toNat (MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_le w (f := F) (d := e)
      (by simpa [F, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_taylor] using he)) (by simp)

theorem index_unique [Unique σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    index P α r =
      (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (α default) (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ P) : ℝ) / r default := by
  set q := Polynomial.taylor (α default) (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ P) with hqdef
  have key (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : eval α (hasseDeriv d P) = q.coeff (d default) := by
    rw [Polynomial.taylor_coeff, ← uniqueAlgEquiv_hasseDeriv, ← Finsupp.unique_single d]
    exact (eval₂_uniqueAlgEquiv (f := hasseDeriv d P) (φ := RingHom.id ℝ) (a := α)).symm
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [hqdef, Ne, Polynomial.taylor_eq_zero, map_eq_zero_iff _ (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ).injective]
  rw [Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree, ← Polynomial.taylor_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa [weight, hqdef] using index_le_weight (P := P) (α := α) (r := r)
      (d := Finsupp.single default q.natTrailingDegree)
      (by simpa [key] using Polynomial.trailingCoeff_nonzero_iff_nonzero.2 hq)
  · refine (le_index_iff hP).2 fun d hd ↦ ?_
    simpa [weight, hqdef] using div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (by exact_mod_cast Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero (key d ▸ hd))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg (r default))

end Roth

theorem abs_eval_lt_of_le_index {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℝ} {r : Fin m → ℕ}
    (hd : ∀ j, degreeOf j Q ≤ r j) {α c : ℝ} (hidx : c ≤ index Q (fun _ ↦ α) r) {h : Fin m → ℤ}
    {q : Fin m → ℕ} (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (happ : ∀ j, |α - (h j : ℝ) / q j| ≤ 1 / (q j : ℝ) ^ κ)
    (hqr : ∀ j, (q 0 : ℝ) ^ ((r 0 : ℝ) / r j) ≤ q j) {C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ i : Fin m →₀ ℕ, |eval (fun _ ↦ α) (hasseDeriv i Q)| < C) :
    |eval (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) Q| < (∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1)) * C *
      (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) := by
  have hT : 0 < (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq 0) _
  rw [eval_eq_sum_box (fun _ ↦ α) (fun j ↦ (h j : ℝ) / q j) r Q hd]
  -- each term of the Taylor expansion is small
  have hterm : ∀ d ∈ box r, |eval (fun _ ↦ α) (hasseDeriv d Q) *
      ∏ j, ((h j : ℝ) / q j - α) ^ d j| < C * (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) := by
    intro d _
    by_cases h0 : eval (fun _ ↦ α) (hasseDeriv d Q) = 0
    · rw [h0, zero_mul, abs_zero]
      exact mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg _) (hC 0)) hT
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le_of_nonneg_of_pos (hC d)
      (abs_prod_pow_le_rpow_of_le_weight hq hκ (fun j ↦ by
        simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using happ j) hqr d (hidx.trans (index_le_weight h0)))
      (abs_nonneg _) hT
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans_lt ?_
  convert Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty ⟨0, mem_box.2 fun j ↦ Nat.zero_le _⟩ hterm using 1
  rw [Finset.sum_const, card_box, nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  ring
